name: linkedin-mcp-server
description: Research LinkedIn through a local, browser-backed MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Research profiles, companies, jobs, posts, and messages.
interface.longDescription: Use your own LinkedIn browser session to research profiles, companies, jobs, posts, and messages in Codex. Write actions require an explicit request. This is an independent open-source integration and is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
defaultPrompt: Find LinkedIn jobs that match my criteria.
